items.claim: Alexa Grasso has the style to give Amanda Lemos trouble with takedowns.

items.quote: She has okay takedown defense. She knows how to split the legs and face the face the hand and get some wrist control, but she never really puts it all together.

items.quote: Steven Asplund with heavy hands going to give him problems with the combos.
